QuestInfo.name: Cygnus Knight Awakening
QuestInfo.0: A strange energy pulses through you, making you feel lighter and stronger. See what Empress Cygnus has to say.
QuestInfo.1: A strange energy pulses through you, making you feel lighter and stronger. See what Empress Cygnus has to say.
QuestInfo.2: After awakening the power of her Alliance members, the Empress undertakes a dangerous mission to enhance the power of the Maple Alliance as a whole. On a silent dawn in Ereve, the Explorers and Cygnus Knights find themselves awakening to their true potential.

0.0: #h0#, did you feel my calling?\r\n#L0##bEmpress? Wha-what happened to me?#l\n#k
0.1: My first act to boost the Maple Alliance was to awaken the inner strength of the lost Heroes and the members of the Resistance. I, too, underwent a transformation, though it was not my intent.\r\n#L0##bOf course, Empress, but what is this strange force I feel? I-it feels like your strength...#l\n#k
0.2: You are right, but you are also wrong. This is the strength lying in wait inside you. I merely awakened it with my call. At the break of dawn, when the moon's light still fully enveloped Ereve, I reached out and my touch found the hearts of all of Maple World.\r\n#L0##bThat's too dangerous! Even for you, Empress!#l\n#k
0.3: I appreciate your concern. Neinheart would be proud of your furrowed brow, but do not worry. My own strength is grown since I aided the other members of the Alliance. As Empress, I must do whatever needs be done for the sake of our lands.\r\n#L0##bWere all of the Cygnus Knights affected like me?#l\n#k
0.4: My touch found the other Cygnus Knights as well as the Explorers. The Maple Alliance needs your power, all of it, to succeed. You must take this strength and learn to control it, for the good of us all. Otherwise, your life will fall to ruin. Will you prove yourself to me?

yes.0: I believe in you. I believe in the future we all share.

no.0: Why do you hesitate? Show me your pride as a member of the Cygnus Knights.
